h1.cap: A bird escaped its cage... without breaking a single bar.

n3.cap: A merchant heads to India. His caged parrot says... tell the wild parrots I'm locked in here.

q1.cap: He does... "On hearing it one of them at once fell down dead."

n4.cap: Back home, his parrot hears this... and drops. Thrown out... it flies to a branch. Alive.

q2.cap: The wild parrot "had only feigned death to suggest this way of escaping from confinement in a cage."

n5.cap: In Rumi's full verse, the message was... your sweet voice keeps you caged.

n6.cap: The gift that wins you praise... can become your cage.

n7.cap: The top student who never risks a wrong answer. The joker who can't say he's hurt.

n8.cap: Freedom isn't smashing bars. It's dropping the performance.

n9.cap: Today, do one thing nobody will clap for... just to grow.

n10.cap: What were you praised into? One word, in the comments.

n11.cap: Follow Awazzzz for tomorrow morning's lesson.
